title: Smoky Skewers with Russian Onion Salsa
description: A fusion of Mexican flavors with the bold taste of smoky skewers and a tangy Russian onion salsa. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: Soak skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Thread 2-3 onions, 1-2 chunks of cheese, and a few sprigs of rosemary onto each skewer.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side or until onions are tender and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, mix together Russian onion, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Serve skewers hot with a dollop of Russian onion salsa and melted cheese.
